collect.comment: US-048 reconciliation: the leftover config pointed at a different, multi-page architecture (/en/, /es/about/, /es/research/<slug>/ …) that does not exist here — this is a single-page site with exactly two routes, / (EN) and /es/ (ES). staticDistDir serves the built dist/ and auto-discovers both index.html pages, so no stale URL can 404 the run.

assertMatrix.comment: Desktop budgets (manual §2 success metrics / §14): Performance >= 90 and LCP < 2.5 s, plus the Accessibility >= 95 metric (US-049/US-050) and a CLS guard. Applies to both single-page routes. The MOBILE budgets (Performance >= 80, LCP < 4 s) live in .lighthouserc.mobile.json. The initial-JS <= 250 KB gz ceiling is enforced separately and deterministically by `npm run gate:js` (scripts/gates/js-budget.mjs), which runs in CI before the artifact upload.
